projects.title: Shayaak — Wellness App, Live on the Web and the App Store
projects.summary: Wellness app with an AI companion, live on the web and the App Store.
projects.description: A full-stack wellness app (journal, tasks, goals, time and weight tracking) with Saya, an AI companion that calls 16 tools through a provider-neutral layer: the model decides, deterministic server code executes, and destructive actions can only be proposed. React (Vite) shipped natively to iOS via Capacitor with a hand-written Swift StoreKit 2 plugin; Node/Express + SQLite backend with 250+ automated tests; dual-rail billing (Stripe on web, Apple In-App Purchase on iOS with server-side receipt verification). Designed, built, released through App Store review and operated solo on my own Linux VPS.
projects.note: Private repo (commercial product): architecture walkthrough on request.

projects.title: Keeps Running — Multi-Agent Front Desk for Small Offices
projects.summary: Four AI agents run a small office's front desk; code gates every action.
projects.description: One engine running four AI agents for a small office: answer and book new inquiries, chase paperwork, read documents, keep clients updated. The model decides and code gates every action: every outbound message is held for the owner's approval, with SSN/card masking and per-person send caps. Hybrid document pipeline (on-server RapidOCR first, vision LLM only for low-confidence pages), AWS SES/S3/SNS inbound mail with verified signatures, Stripe billing, a 45-case LLM eval suite and 149 offline tests.
projects.note: Private repo: live test instance, walkthrough on request.

projects.title: Sandbox City — Crash-Test Lab for AI Shopping Agents
projects.summary: Crash-test AI shopping agents, price each payment defense, enforce the winner at a real PayPal checkout.
projects.description: Gives an AI agent a PayPal key and finds out what a malicious store page can make it do. In testing, a real model was talked into a $1,620 order shipped to an attacker's PO box on the PayPal sandbox. Sandbox City tests your own agent against 16 cases, prices each payment defense over 30 simulated days with 95% intervals, then enforces the winning rulebook at a real PayPal checkout (Orders v2, Agent Toolkit). It uses a crash-safe payment journal: a test kills the process mid-capture, and the customer is still charged exactly once.

projects.title: WoundTrace — Agentic Computer Vision on AWS
projects.summary: Wound area in cm² from one phone photo: an Amazon Bedrock agent with 9 tools, an OpenCV segmenter at Dice 0.82 on clinical photos, and serverless on AWS Lambda.
projects.description: Measure a wound from one phone photo: an Amazon Bedrock agent (Converse API, 9 tools) checks the photo, rejects tilted or blurred shots with a specific retake instruction, measures area in cm² with its uncertainty, and drafts a nurse note when healing stalls; a human approves every alert. The OpenCV segmentation model, trained in PyTorch, scores Dice 0.82 on 200 expert-annotated clinical photos, with zero false outlines on 1,378 healthy-foot photos. Deployed serverless on AWS Lambda.

projects.title: Multi-Channel YouTube Content Agent

projects.description: A 7-stage pipeline running on my own Linux server since May 2026 across 4 channels: trend discovery, research, scriptwriting, neural TTS, video assembly and scheduled uploads. As of Nov 16, 2026 it has published 265 videos from 272 runs (97%), with per-channel failure isolation and alerts that fall back from Discord to Telegram to email. Private repo.
